## Testing

Describe the Windows versions and scenarios tested.

- [ ] Release build succeeds
- [ ] CI passes
- [ ] CodeQL passes
- [ ] Relevant app rule profiles tested

Security vulnerabilities must be reported privately according to SECURITY.md, not disclosed in a public PR.
